tellings.difference: Told secondhand by Jesse Michels, who says Grusch told him in a car ride in DC. It leaves out the detail about colleagues' grandparents handling UFO reports.
tellings.link_reason: Both tellings claim, on Grusch's word, that the Manhattan Project was the first UFO program, the forerunner of Blue Book, in the 1940s United States.

as_told.title: Grusch: the Manhattan Project was the original UFO program

plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence official who went public with claims about hidden UFO programmes, says some of his colleagues had grandparents who handled UFO reports for the Manhattan Project, the secret American effort to build the atomic bomb in the 1940s. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Grusch told him during a car ride in Washington that the Manhattan Project was basically the original UFO programme, a forerunner of Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s. If true, it would mean the government was studying UFOs even before the famous sightings of the late 1940s.
